decision_question: What exact HDS-semantic test subjects require one tier and named CI selection, and who may bind that scope?

recommendation.rule: Keep semantic scope and gate HOLD until a G decision adopts a typed, versioned subject inventory plus generic checker. Inventory exact module/node, owner, status, closed basis (invariant-negative, fitness-proof, direct-validation-consumer, owner-attested); reconcile invariant/fitness refs, direct importers, one tier, actual job selection, and skip/xfail admissibility. Missing/extra/stale/unowned bindings HOLD. Migrate 52 candidates only after per-subject owner decisions; do not infer from path, owner, purpose, or workflow execution.
recommendation.not_authorized: No source patch, green claim, semantic inventory authority, waiver, or DL-HDS-0014 reopening.

ownership_time_authority.source_owner: Proposed issuer team-architecture-governance; proposed approval team-quality-closeout for tier/lane impact and team-runtime-quality for test mapping. Existing CI-budget owner is team-quality-closeout; semantic owner is not established.
ownership_time_authority.time: Effective only after the G decision, inventory, consumer, negative mutations, admissibility checks, and job-consumption proof land together; revisit first HDS closeout after migration, with no blanket expiry/waiver.
ownership_time_authority.authority_limit: No source patch, green claim, semantic inventory authority, waiver, or DL-HDS-0014 reopening.

alternatives.reuse: Keep existing bounded tier/anti-drift rules; they do not define semantic scope.
alternatives.extend: Recommended after G: typed inventory plus generic consumer of references, tier, job selection, and admissibility.
alternatives.consolidate: Only if the same scope boundary recurs; maintain one canonical inventory/issuer.
alternatives.build_new: Not justified before extending the existing registry and checker.

pattern_pass.acceptance: Real checker derives complete scope from the inventory, detects subject/tier/job/admissibility drift, and fails on a sibling missing all bindings.

falsifiers: Prototype status HOLD; 25 shared negative-node IDs plus 2 proof refs select 23 modules; 13 lack tiers and 14 lie outside the literal 248-module HDS workflow.
The 52 semantic-candidate set is a prior bounded inventory, not authority; 248 is execution scope, not semantic membership.
Synthetic falsifiers: missing tier; reference parity deletion; new sibling without scope/tier/CI; skipif/direct pytest.skip; removed job selection.
Bounded residual: new HDS behavior with no typed reference and no registered API import is not detectable from current sources; owner review at admission is required.
